about: Rules for planning synonym changes. scripts/synonym_plan.py reads this file, so change a limit here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/synonym-writes.md explains how the write tools behave.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: At most this many ready creates, updates and disables go in one batch, which gets one explicit yes. Blocked and no_change changes don't count. Deletes, reverts and every change that switches a synonym on are always batches of one, with a yes each.
notes.max_words_per_term: Each synonym term may have at most this many words (the synonym tools reject longer terms).
notes.forbidden_characters: Characters a synonym term must not contain (the synonym tools say not to use quotes).
notes.running_statuses: Experiment statuses that count as running, compared case-insensitively (RUNNING and running match). An experiment with no status also counts as running. A change to a synonym whose terms a running experiment mentions is blocked.
